# Installer instructions

For installer changes, read `.github/skills/wixsharp-installer/SKILL.md`, then inspect actual C# authoring and package versions. Preserve multi-version Revit selection, per-user installation, ARP/maintenance and upgrade behavior. Check generated files/manifests and report which Windows MSI scenarios were actually tested.
